constraints.source: Weekdays I'm up at 7 and asleep by 11.
constraints.paraphrase: On weekday mornings you're up at 7, so you're asleep by 11pm Sunday through Thursday nights.

constraints.source: I like math in the morning
constraints.paraphrase: You'd prefer to do MATH 2940 work in the morning, before noon.
You'd prefer to do ENGL 1170 work in the afternoon, between noon and 6pm.
No work scheduled on Friday evenings, from 6pm onward.
